svg.text: MXBM GPU solver: throughput and solve time
One point per committed optimization, in order. LINEAR axes from zero: equal height = equal absolute change.

circle.title: 2026-07-23 First working GPU solver (first share found) 1050.0 ms · 1.8 sol/s
2026-07-23 Sort-based collision finder (P1–P3) 239.0 ms · 8.0 sol/s
2026-07-23 Tiled 4-bit × 6-pass radix sort (P4) 225.0 ms · 8.4 sol/s
2026-07-24 Fixed-width AoS compaction `[7,7,6,5,1]` 214.5 ms · 8.9 sol/s
2026-07-24 Fused row-bucket pipeline (STEP A–C) 148.0 ms · 12.8 sol/s
2026-07-24 L5-thin: drop round-5 leaf payload 139.1 ms · 13.7 sol/s
2026-07-24 Per-round work compaction on row-bucket 136.0 ms · 14.0 sol/s
2026-07-24 Async enqueue (de-bubble) 133.0 ms · 14.3 sol/s
2026-07-24 Compact `leftContrib` (fold 8 leaves → 1 u64) 124.8 ms · 15.2 sol/s
2026-07-24 Packed element record (1 block, not 4 arrays) 115.7 ms · 16.4 sol/s
2026-07-24 Re-derive round-1 seeds from indices 102.7 ms · 18.5 sol/s
2026-07-24 Defer round-1's seed expand to a non-divergent loop 95.3 ms · 19.9 sol/s
2026-07-24 Round 2 re-derives from a 16 B pair record 86.8 ms · 21.9 sol/s
2026-07-24 Round 3 re-derives from a 24 B quad record (later reverted) 83.2 ms · 22.8 sol/s
2026-07-24 Bake per-round constants into the fused kernels 56.2 ms · 33.8 sol/s
2026-07-24 Retire the round-3 quad record + per-set stride sizing 54.0 ms · 35.2 sol/s
2026-07-24 Drop the redundant `lead` from the round-3 record 52.7 ms · 36.1 sol/s
2026-07-24 Round 5 stores 1 work word, not 5 47.5 ms · 40.0 sol/s
2026-07-24 Retune row-bucket geometry to (15, 2) 42.7 ms · 44.5 sol/s
2026-07-24 √-scaled bucket capacity → geometry (16, 1) 40.4 ms · 47.0 sol/s
2026-07-25 CUDA port, algorithm unchanged 41.6 ms · 47.6 sol/s
2026-07-25 128-bit access on the round-2/3 records 38.4 ms · 51.6 sol/s
2026-07-25 128-bit access on the remaining records 35.2 ms · 56.1 sol/s
2026-07-25 Un-pad round 2's record — 9th word to its own plane 35.0 ms · 56.4 sol/s
2026-07-26 Perfect chain table + group spill → `kFCap` 320 34.1 ms · 58.0 sol/s
2026-07-31 Speculative entry co-scheduling — r4's launch hosts the next nonce's entry as interleaved co-blocks 33.4 ms · 59.5 sol/s
2026-07-31 Below-the-floor pair: r2's 16 B record in one `LD.128` + the terminal round joins the perfect table 33.2 ms · 59.7 sol/s
2026-08-13 Implicit-bits record — the packed r2 record stops storing the key bits its bucket address encodes; the side plane loses its writer and reader 32.0 ms · 62.7 sol/s

2026-08-15 The w0-checkpoint pair record — round 1 stores the child's post-mix work word 0, so round 2 derives only the linear lane (12 siphashes, no mixes); the record stays 16 B because the address-implied key bits pay for word 0 31.3 ms · 64.2 sol/s

2026-08-15 Recovery replays instead of storing reference rows — round 4's row, then its record at 8 B instead of 16, then round 3's row and rows 1–3 with it; recovery re-runs two rounds over one bucket each and reads round 2's four leaves 29.3 ms · 68.6 sol/s

2026-08-16 Two barriers' worth of work that nothing needed — the block-exit `__syncthreads()`, which at stock guards a pass that never runs; then singleton-free staging, which never stages the 12.8 % of a group alone in its chain slot, since a perfect table makes that element provably partnerless 29.1 ms · 69.0 sol/s
